reseed._note: Weekly re-seed of the baseline from the current week's Half PPR medians (dump_projections.mjs) before the nine-way split. implied = average of (A) the seed value of the player's projection-rank slot within the position and (C) the player's share of the position's points-above-replacement mapped onto the position's seed value budget; new = seed + weight x (implied - seed), then rescaled so the total equals the seed total. Players with no projection this week keep their seed value.
